notes: §1985:X.4.2.2 prints three FD formats, each with optional IS EXTERNAL and IS GLOBAL: Format 1 (sequential, §1985:X.4.2.3 SR1) BLOCK, RECORD (CONTAINS / VARYING DEPENDING / m TO n), LABEL, VALUE OF, DATA, LINAGE, CODE-SET; Format 2 (relative or indexed, SR2) the same without LINAGE and CODE-SET; Format 3 (report, SR3) without DATA and LINAGE but with REPORT. BindFileSection decides the format once (FileDescriptionFormats.Of from organization and a REPORT clause) and FileDescriptionClauseAdmitted refuses a clause the format's Rows entry lacks (COBOL2604); fileGlobalExternalClause sets IsExternal/IsGlobal. Probed at 85: Format 1 with every clause including EXTERNAL+GLOBAL, LINAGE, CODE-SET and RECORD VARYING DEPENDING with an ODO record compiles and runs; clauses in any order; Format 2 relative and indexed with EXTERNAL+GLOBAL, DATA RECORDS run (RK must be EXTERNAL, COBOL1624 per §1985:VIII.2.4.4 GR8); LINAGE, CODE-SET and REPORT on Format 2 COBOL2604; Format 3 EXTERNAL+GLOBAL+VARYING+CODE-SET runs, LINAGE COBOL2604, an 01 record COBOL2578; EXTERNAL or GLOBAL twice COBOL2423; 2002+ forms refused COBOL0900 (EXTERNAL AS, BYTES, CODE-SET FOR) and FORMAT COBOL1705. Witness: an EXTERNAL sequential file shared with a nested program, a GLOBAL relative file and a GLOBAL report file. Side lead, another rule: LINAGE + RECORD VARYING sequential file re-opened INPUT gives 39 (SequentialConnector.FixedAttributeConflict checks length-prefix framing on a LINAGE print stream).

next.reason: 1985 IPC FD Formats 1-3 (sequential, relative/indexed, report) carry IS EXTERNAL, IS GLOBAL, BLOCK, RECORD, LABEL RECORD(S), VALUE OF, DATA RECORD(S), LINAGE, CODE-SET and REPORT(S). §2023:13.4.5.2 keeps the three formats with EXTERNAL (§2023:13.18.22.2, now with [AS literal-1]), GLOBAL (§2023:13.18.27.2), BLOCK (§2023:13.18.10.2), RECORD (§2023:13.18.43.2), LINAGE (§2023:13.18.34.2), CODE-SET (§2023:13.18.13.2, adding FOR ALPHANUMERIC/NATIONAL) and REPORT (§2023:13.18.46.2), adds FORMAT, but has no LABEL, VALUE OF or DATA RECORDS clause anywhere, so 1985 entries using them are refused.
